about.title: Sacred Heart School
about.subtitle: Established April 1, 2007 | Katra Chauraha, Nichlaul
about.body: Greeting and welcome to the Sacred Heart Senior Secondary School of Katra Chauraha U.P. on the way of Mandi Road Nichlaul Maharajganj. This school was established on 1st of April 2007 with an aim to provide holistic development to individual students. The school is committed to create an ambience for nurturing innovation, creativity and excellence. Our mission is to inculcate core values and discipline so that students become responsible, aware, humble yet confident individuals. We always believe in learning by doing.

fees.paymentMethods: We accept payments via Online Banking, UPI, Credit/Debit Cards, and direct deposits at the school counter during working hours.
fees.dueDates: Installments are due by the 10th of April, July, October, and January. Late payments may attract a nominal fine as per school policy.
fees.refundPolicy: Fees once paid are non-refundable and non-transferable. Please ensure all details are correct before initiating a transaction.

admission.sessionNote: The new academic session starts in the first week of April. The school follows the CBSE curriculum. The medium of instruction is English at all levels.
courses: Primary: Hindi, English, Mathematics, Env. Sciences, G.K., Art & Craft and Computer
Middle: Hindi, English, Mathematics, Social Studies, Sciences, Computer Technology and Sanskrit
Class IX to XII: Mathematics, Biology and Commerce streams
procedure: Admission is open to all irrespective of caste, creed, colour, religion or gender.
Parents seeking admission should procure prospectus with registration form from the school office on payment.
Duly filled registration form with required documents must be submitted by the given deadline.
Mere submission of registration form does not guarantee admission.
documentsRequired: Passport size photograph of the candidate
T.C in original and marksheet of previous class (attested)
Photocopy of Local Guardian in case of boarding house admission
feeNotes: The school fee is submitted quarterly.
The admission fee is paid up front.
See the Fee Structure page for class-wise details.
withdrawals: A student will be issued written transfer certificate on written intimation with one month notice / notice fee.
No certificate is given until all school dues are cleared and verified.
A student may be asked to leave on grounds of indiscipline, irregularity, misconduct, non-payment of fee, or unsatisfactory academics.
admission.uniformNote: At the commencement of each academic session parents arrange uniforms for their ward. Uniforms must follow school designs and shape.

aboutExtended.philosophy: At Sacred Heart School, we believe that every child is unique and capable of achieving greatness. Our philosophy is centered on providing a holistic education that nurtures the intellectual, emotional, and spiritual development of each student. We are dedicated to creating a safe, inclusive, and supportive environment where curiosity, creativity, and critical thinking are encouraged.
aboutExtended.mission: At Sacred Heart School, our mission is to provide a nurturing and inclusive environment where every student is inspired to grow academically, socially, and spiritually. We are committed to fostering values of respect, kindness, and excellence, empowering our students to become responsible, compassionate, and confident individuals who will positively impact the world.
